# SamurrAI

> > SamurrAI is a comprehensive AI tools directory and resource hub featuring reviews, tutorials, and industry updates on ChatGPT, Gemini, automation platforms, and emerging AI technologies.

Founded by Anmol Chitransh, SamurrAI helps professionals discover and master AI tools across marketing, customer support, video generation, and workflow automation. The platform covers cutting-edge solutions like CustomGPT.ai, N8N, Genspark AI Browser, and Google's latest AI innovations.
